messages:
claire: Quick brainstorm 10m: run a micro-demo + seed experiment targeting devs. Funnel: launch post -> 20m live demo -> instant 150-token credit + 3 prompt templates -> activation nudges. Objective: lift 3-day active rate.
devin: Nice. Suggest we also test a no-template control to measure template uplift. Two arms: template vs no-template.
leo: Can we split seed amounts too? maybe 150 vs 400 tokens. But that increases arms. If traffic low, collapse to single seed.
priya: Analytics: events we need: demo_reg, seed_issued, template_used, first_call_24h, active_3d. Add utm_source and campaign_id on demo_reg.
priya: Routing plan: organic post -> utm=demo_org, tweet -> utm=demo_social, newsletter -> utm=demo_nl. Map to source in signup payload.
claire: Good. Devin, will you own cohort assignment logic? needs to handle seed_size and template_flag deterministic per signup.
devin: Yes. Cohort assignment rules: hash(email)%100 < 50 -> control else treatment. For seeds: within treatment further hash(email)%2 toggle between 150/400. Will share mapping snippet.
leo: Product question: do we expose a one-click "apply starter pack" in console? that'll improve template uptake.
marco: Marketing can build the landing with CTA that links to console deep-link. But product needs a route to accept campaign params. Sam handled before; tagging dev team in follow-up.
claire: promo-bot, please schedule demo date next week and push a small paid spend if organic < 50 signups/day.
promo-bot: demo_event created -> 1722580000; reminders="48h,2h"; paid_fallback_threshold=50/day.
priya: Benchmarks: historical 3-day active = 12% for similar quickstarts. Hypothesis: templates + 400 tokens -> +6-8pp, templates + 150 -> +3-4pp, no-templates -> baseline. Need ~200 users per arm for 80% power.
claire: We can't guarantee that. Prioritize template vs no-template with single 150 seed then run second round if numbers permit.
devin: Also implement abuse filters: block free seeds for emails from disposable domains, and cap seeds per domain to 5. Log suspicious signups to #fraud.
leo: Creative: 3 headline variants for launch post: A) "Ship your first Redwood prompt in 20m" B) "Free demo + starter tokens" C) "Templates for real product tasks". We'll A/B test on organic.
marco: I'll coordinate newsletter blurb and include a "save your seat" CTA linking to the landing and to the console deep-link after signup.
priya: Data pipeline: emit demo_reg with campaign_id, cohort, seed_amount, template_id. Need to propagate to looker for daily cohort metrics and funnel viz. Also send raw events to S3 for ad-hoc analysis.
claire: Ops note: follow-up nudges schedule: 1h after demo -> checklist email + template highlight; 24h -> reminder to redeem tokens; 72h -> success stories + office hours invite.
devin: Example signup API (engineering):
```
POST /api/v1/marketing/demo-signup
{
  "email":"x",
  "utm":"demo_org",
  "campaign_id":"microlab-apr",
  "company_size":"..."
}
```
Response: {"cohort":"...","seed":150,"template_ids":["tpl_onboard","tpl_support"]}
priya: We'll track template usage by template_id and tag template_used events with template_id and prompt_hash.
leo: Who curates templates? Marketing + Product pair to ensure they're short, actionable, and map to clear outcomes. I can draft 4: onboarding, changelog-summarizer, feature-req-gen, code-explain.
marco: Risk: spam signups taking seeds. Mitigations: disposable-domain block, company_size gating (no edu/students), rate limits per IP, and post-run audit.
claire: Timeline: landing + creative ready in 36h, signup route and cohort wiring 48h, templates live 36h, analytics events wired 72h, dashboard live 96h.
priya: I'll create the minimal dashboard: signups/day, conversion to first_call_24h, template_use_rate, active_3d by cohort.
devin: One more: include referrer header and landing fingerprint to help dedupe multi-email signups from same org.
marco: Office hours: run 2 sessions in the week after demo. Use Calendly & track RSVPs as event office_rsvp.
claire: Final gating: proceed if we can hit ~300 total signups in first week. Otherwise hold paid fallback.
promo-bot: campaign checklist posted -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKTG-558
claire: Thanks all. I'll post the short brief in #launches and assign tasks. :rocket:
